title: CareGraph: An Auditable Hybrid AI Framework for Evidence-Grounded Personalized Longitudinal Health Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2608.27484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence is transforming personalized healthcare, yet fragmented clinical, self reported, and wearable evidence remains difficult to interpret and trace. We present CareGraph, an auditable hybrid AI framework that converts heterogeneous records into prioritized trends, missing context indicators, bounded next steps, discussion questions, and provenance linked explanations. CareGraph organizes evidence without diagnosing, predicting outcomes, selecting treatment, or making autonomous clinical decisions. Its pipeline covers deterministic analysis, context detection, graph construction, constrained language model synthesis, evidence validation, safety controls, and release gating. Tests used synthetic cohorts of 400 patients each for development, validation, and holdout. translated_title: CareGraph：一个可审计的、基于证据的个性化纵向健康智能混合AI框架
translated_abstract: 人工智能正在变革个性化医疗，然而分散的临床数据、自我报告数据和可穿戴设备证据仍然难以解释和追溯。我们提出了CareGraph，这是一个可审计的混合AI框架，能够将异构记录转换为按优先级排序的趋势、缺失上下文指标、有边界的后续步骤、讨论问题以及带有溯源链接的解释。CareGraph仅负责组织证据，而不进行诊断、预测结果、选择治疗方案或做出自主临床决策。其处理流程涵盖确定性分析、上下文检测、图构建、受限语言模型综合、证据验证、安全控制和发布门控。测试使用了三个各含400名患者的合成队列，分别用于开发、验证和保留测试。在保留数据上，带有充分性门控的冻结普通最小二乘趋势规则达到了0.827的准确率和0.837的宏F1分数，95%置信度……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CareGraph是一个可审计的混合AI框架，通过图构建与受限语言模型，将分散的临床、自报和可穿戴设备证据转化为可溯源的个性化纵向健康趋势分析与有边界的建议，同时严格避免做出自主临床决策。
en_tdlr: CareGraph is an auditable hybrid AI framework that uses graph construction and constrained language models to convert fragmented clinical, self-reported, and wearable evidence into traceable personalized longitudinal health trend analyses and bounded recommendations, while explicitly avoiding autonomous clinical decision-making.
